remarks:
Opportunity awaits with this 3-bedroom, 1 full bath two-story home located in Kennedy, NY. This property needs TLC and is being sold as-is. Cash deal only. The home features hardwood floors, and eat-in country kitchen with vinyl flooring, and main-floor laundry conveniently located in the kitchen. The living room offers wood floors and a fireplace (fireplace condition is unknown and should be inspected and serviced before use).

The second floor features three bedrooms and a full bath. Additional features include a partial basement, forced-air heat, private water and sewer, an enclosed porch, and a detached garage. Situated on a spacious lot, this property offers plenty of room for outdoor activities and improvements. Bring your vision and make this home your own!
